note: Catalogue capture for the International MaxxPro. The identity and the overall length, width and height rest on the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article. The weights, ground clearance, angles, ford depth, turning radius, top speed, engine, transmission, wheels and tyres rest on the held tier-2 US Army operator manual TM 9-2355-106-10 for the M1224 and M1224A1.

gears.locator: Table 11, Transmission Speeds, page 0002-32, row Forward Five
